attempts.cause: The view customer_tiers_v incorrectly selects the tier based on the maximum min_spend strictly less than annual_spend, which fails for exact matches on min_spend.
attempts.candidate:
create or replace view customer_tiers_v as
-- Loyalty tier of each customer: the highest tier whose minimum spend the customer has reached.
select c.customer_id, t.tier_name, t.discount_pct
  from shop_customers c, discount_tiers t
 where t.min_spend <= c.annual_spend
order by t.min_spend desc
fetch first 1 row only;
/

attempts.cause: The view customer_tiers_v was changed to use FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY, but the logic for selecting the highest tier whose minimum spend is met is still flawed when multiple tiers match or when the original logic was intended to find the highest matching tier.
attempts.candidate:
create or replace view customer_tiers_v as
-- Loyalty tier of each customer: the highest tier whose minimum spend the customer has reached.
select c.customer_id, t.tier_name, t.discount_pct
  from shop_customers c, discount_tiers t
 where t.min_spend <= c.annual_spend
  and not exists (
    select 1
    from discount_tiers t2
    where t2.min_spend > t.min_spend
      and t2.min_spend <= c.annual_spend
  )
/
